title: monTEK Single Monitor Arm for Max 45 Inch Ultrawide Screens Adjustable Monitor Desk Mount Holds 35 Lbs Cable Management with Clamp/Grommet Desk Mount, VESA 75/100mm
features: Wide Compatibility for Versatile Use: This single monitor arm perfectly fits most flat or curved screens ranging from 17" to 45", supporting a maximum load of 35.27 lbs for stable performance. Fully compliant with VESA 75x75mm and 100x100mm standards. Ideal for office workstations, home setups, and gaming rigs, our monitor mount adapts to diverse usage scenarios with reliable compatibility.

Full Motion Monitor Arm: The vesa monitor mount delivers precise, effortless adjustments to tailor your viewing experience: tilt from -45° to +90°, swivel ±90°, rotate ±180°, and adjust height from 8.8-20.4in. Designed for ergonomics, these adjustments let you position your screen exactly where you need it—whether raising to reduce neck strain, angling for comfortable reading.

Streamline Desktop Space: monTEK single monitor mount features a compact, low-profile base and elevated arm design, lifting your screen off the surface to free up valuable desk space. The ultrawide monitor arm also features integrated cable management, keeping power lines hidden and untangled, for a workspace that stays sleek, spacious, and clutter-free.

Constructed to Endure: Crafted with high-grade aluminum, these monitor arms blends robust build with reliable precision mechanics—engineered for consistent performance and lasting strength. It delivers stable, controlled adjustments without wear or tension loss, while the single monitor mount's precision system ensures smooth movement with every adjustment, keeping your screen secure through years of use.

Simple Setup, Stellar Support: The vesa monitor mount comes with both a C-clamp and grommet base mount to fit most desks seamlessly. It installs in minutes with all hardware and clear instructions included. Should you have any questions about your monitor mount, our team is always ready to assist just reach out anytime.

Compatibility Check Required: Please verify your monitor's size, weight, and VESA pattern before ordering. For curved monitors, please note that due to the deep recessed mounting holes on certain models, you may need to purchase longer bolts (typically 30mm) and use spacers to ensure a secure fit. If you're unsure about fitment or whether a separate mounting adapter is required, we highly suggest reaching out to our support team for professional guidance.
